title: Trends in proton-pump inhibitor use among Danish adults: a nationwide drug utilization study 2015-2023
authors: Lundgaard KM, Christiansen MØ, Sonne H, Mose K, Nyland N, Andersen MJL, et al.
population: All Danish adults filling at least one PPI prescription, nationwide prescription and patient registers; in-hospital and over-the-counter use not captured; indications not recorded
funder: The authors received no specific funding for this work.
authorConflicts: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
result: Prevalence of PPI use rose from 7.0% of adults in 2015 to 8.2% in 2023, with incidence stable at about 3 users per 100 person-years. Three years after initiation 17% used PPIs and 1.5% had remained on continuous treatment. Allowing for treatment breaks, 34% of new users aged 80 years or older were still treated after 1 year and 30% after 3 years, against 8.7% and 7.6% of those aged 18 to 39. In 2023, 50% of users also used ulcerogenic drugs.
